references.text: Parallel text describing the eight planks and their sixteen silver sockets in the instructions for the tabernacle, which are here carried out in practice.
Earlier verses in the same chapter describing the pattern of two sockets under each plank, which is repeated here.
Nearby verses that also mention planks and silver sockets in the construction of the tabernacle.
